Kuvitus: koulun pihalla on kaksi kaiutin: Illustration: two loudspeakers on stands side by side in a school yard. Sound spreads from both as concentric arcs, and the arcs overlap. In front of the loudspeakers a student walks along a path across the yard and listens.
Kaavakuva: kaksi pulssia kohtaa narussa,: Diagram: two pulses meet on a string, two cases side by side and three moments one below the other. On the left the pulses are equally large and on the same side of the string; at the moment of meeting the displacement of the string is the sum of the displacements of the pulses, twice as large. On the right the pulses are equally large but on opposite sides; at the moment of meeting they cancel each other and the string is straight for a moment. After meeting, in both cases the pulses continue with their original shapes in their own directions. The individual pulses are drawn with dashed lines at the moment of meeting.
Kaavakuva ylhäältä: kaksi samassa vaihee: Diagram from above: two sources S1 and S2 vibrating in phase at the bottom edge of a ripple tank, two wavelengths apart. Circular waves spread from each: wave crests as continuous and wave troughs as dashed blue arcs. Where a crest meets a crest, the interference is constructive; these places are on continuous black lines whose path difference is 0 or one wavelength. Between them are dashed black nodal lines, where a crest meets a trough and the path difference is a half or one and a half wavelengths. The pattern is to scale.
Kaavakuva: lähteet S1 ja S2 ovat vasemma: Diagram: sources S1 and S2 are on the left one below the other, and point P is on the right. The distance from source S1 to point P is s1 and from source S2 it is s2. An arc of radius s2 drawn around point P cuts the segment S1P. The thick segment between the cutting point and source S1 is the path difference, delta s = s1 − s2. Not to scale.
Kaavakuva: kahden aallon poikkeamat pist: Diagram: the displacements of two waves at point P as a function of time and their sum, two cases side by side. On the left the path difference is one wavelength: the blue and the purple wave are in phase, crest on crest, and the amplitude of the sum is double. On the right the path difference is half a wavelength: the waves are in opposite phase, crest on trough, and the sum is zero all the time.
Kaavakuva kahdessa osassa. Ylhäällä kolm: Diagram in two parts. At the top three sine waves with frequencies 220, 660 and 1100 hertz and amplitudes in the ratio one, one third and one fifth, as thin lines, and their sum as a thick black curve, which is already almost the shape of a square wave. At the bottom the spectrum of the same sum: vertical bars at the frequencies 220, 660 and 1100 hertz, with lengths in the ratio of the amplitudes.
